nativeSourceBasis: Exact composed-source files, every byte/hash checked against the original4868-member manifest; not current upstream.

sourceRoute.observation: The real path sends native block models and range to BlockCopy/BlockCut and forwards returned text/html/block slots to the original pasteboard helper. It does not invoke shared PinkhaSemanticText.clipboardText.
Ordinary copy/cut exports the supplied native text mark parameters; ranged export uses RangeCut then offsets the same marks. No reserved semantic-marker filter exists.

Text copying and range splitting retain mark Type and Param. State normalization handles tree/layout/details and optional Normalize implementers; neither Text nor embedded Base implements a semantic-marker normalization.

Paste sanitizes mark ranges only, remaps block IDs/children, and retains valid link Params. Inline insertion also carries copied mark Params into the target. A valid pinkha-anchor URL is not retired or reminted.

consequence: A copied anchored text/block can carry the original durable identity into another native text location. In the same document this can produce duplicate/noncontiguous fragments and resolver ambiguity; in a different document the marker retains the old owner instead of becoming ordinary pasted text. The resolver safely refuses foreign/ambiguous state, but that refusal does not satisfy the specified clipboard no-cloning behavior.
scopeLimits: This is source reachability and exact8ac data-flow evidence, not an executed clipboard/native/UI test.
This audit does not claim Heart before/inside/after UIKit typing is broken; it forwards real marks and remains a separate mounted acceptance obligation.
Existing native capture/CAS evidence and old accepted tests remain unchanged.
requiredOwner: Wave1 for the existing native clipboard behavior; coordinate any Native source change. No Wave2 UI-only stripping or duplicate contract.
minimalRegressionRequirements: Copy and cut full/partial anchored text: clipboard payload has no reserved marker identity while actual document preservation and cut Undo use the original native history.
Paste copied native slots in same and different document: preserve ordinary text/formatting/links, never clone the original anchor.
Paste supplied reserved-marker slots: no untrusted marker identity injection, including future/malformed reserved shapes under the agreed existing contract.
Keep ordinary nonsemantic link/mark and code-paste behavior unchanged; retain explicit actual source/inverse and run only affected tests.
